tick_origin: GameTest tick 0 after the left motor is set to 32 RPM. Samples follow actions on each test tick.

lanes.0: unpowered Gearshift opposing the Clutch input
lanes.1: powered Gearshift making the competing inputs compatible

rpm: Signed theoretical RPM, zero when the block entity is absent. Values in these lanes are integral.
drops: Number of Clutch item entities within one block of the Clutch bounds.

gearshift_drop_capture.sample: After the final trace sample, destroy the two remaining Gearshifts in place with drops enabled.
